answers.description: Independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning. Dogs, prams and muddy boots all welcome.

headline: Canalside café
in Hebden Bridge
Warm welcome
hero.subhead: Your independent café by the canal, serving breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked each morning.

items.description: Our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven.
Start your day with a proper breakfast by the water, simple food cooked with care.
Made to order using good bread and simple fillings, a canalside favourite.

services.heading: Breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked here each morning.

about.statement: We wanted a café on the canal where everyone feels welcome, muddy boots, dogs and prams included.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We're on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.question: Can I bring my dog?
items.answer: Of course. Bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots, everyone's welcome here.

items.question: What's on the menu?
items.answer: Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked that morning. Simple food cooked with care.

items.question: How do I order?
items.answer: Settle in at a table, then order at the counter. We'll bring it over when it's ready.

items.question: Are the cakes fresh?
items.answer: Yes, our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven.

footer.tagline: A warm welcome by the canal.
footer.credit: Bramble and Bean, by the canal.
